feature_under_test: joint Atoll Server and same-node MySQL process loss while a real-Chrome request is in flight

environment.mysql: ephemeral MySQL 8.4 with separate non-root staircase_migrator and staircase_runtime accounts
environment.database_storage: test-only restartable Docker data volume removed during cleanup
environment.stable_runtime_endpoint: test-process transparent TCP proxy retargeted to the restarted container's published port

fault_cut.browser_state_before_cut: Attempt running, no Artifact persisted, and controlled origin accepted exactly one document request
fault_cut.cut: block the stable runtime endpoint, SIGKILL Atoll Server and MySQL, hold both control-plane dependencies down for seven seconds, restart the same MySQL data first, verify database connectivity while Server is absent, then restart Server

invariants: Server and MySQL receive SIGKILL only after the Attempt is running, the request reached the origin, and no Artifact exists
the execution daemon remains the same OS process while both control-plane dependencies are absent
MySQL and its durable data recover before Atoll Server is restarted
the original Attempt expires without accepted evidence and its Permit and source dispatch settle
the same Executor Actor identity reconnects with a new incarnation and accepts exactly one recovery dispatch
the recovery Attempt produces exactly one accepted DOM response, one effect trace, and one BackfillOutput
all Permits and dispatches settle, and a final normal Server restart preserves state and both Resource reads

implementation.reused_production_behavior: existing durable Attempt TTL, acceptance fence, source-dispatch settlement, attempt_recovered dispatch, daemon reconnect, and immutable result protocols

non_claims: zero-refetch result spooling: two website requests are expected because the daemon has no durable local result spool after Server loss
primary/replica failover, multi-node quorum behavior, or remote-network recovery
point-in-time recovery, corrupted storage, data loss, or regional disaster recovery

acceptance.gate: P9 joint local control-plane dependency loss during an in-flight real-Chrome request
